but it's found in a person, and that person is Christ.
He is God incarnate, the one that dwells among us.
He is our strength and He is worthy of our trust, for He is the way, the truth, and the
life.
True, genuine, lasting happiness is found in Him and Him alone.
Let's pray.
Lord God, we do praise You for who You are.
We praise You that You are the God who intimately loves Your people.
You are the God that dwells among us.
May we not lose sight of that reality.
You have given us your very self.
And so Lord, we find joy in our life now
reflecting on that reality,
and we also find joy as we look to the future.
When all peoples, through all times
who have proclaimed your name,
get to gather before your throne
and praise you forevermore.
Lord God, we praise you that in you and you alone,
we can find a joy, a happiness, a blessedness
that is unending.
So in your name we pray, amen.
